summary.label: Summary
summary.text: Software engineer and frontend lead with over 6 years shipping production web products in **React**, **TypeScript**, and **Node.js** across payments, Web3, and AI platforms built by fully remote teams.

bullets: Architected a **B2B cross-border payment** platform from concept to alpha in **React** and **Tailwind CSS** across an 8-month engagement.
Engineered **Node.js**, **Express**, and **MongoDB** services with **Python** microservices for financial data analysis and reporting.
Integrated **Mastercard Digital Asset Solutions** and shipped a real-time multi-branch liquidity dashboard.
Delivered features for an **AI conversational commerce** platform in **React**, powering campaigns across 3 channels: WhatsApp, Messenger, and Discord.
Engineered **Go** and **PostgreSQL** services on **AWS** for high-concurrency messaging, and migrated the customer inbox from **Redux** to **Jotai**.
Directed frontend architecture for a **Web3 social platform** aggregating cross-chain assets and NFTs, leading a distributed engineering team.
Migrated the legacy **Angular** codebase to **React/Next.js** and built multi-wallet authentication ahead of WalletConnect.
Directed 4 technical functions — web engineering, UI/UX, IT infrastructure, and digital marketing — across a client portfolio.
Supervised offshore teams building **React**, **Angular**, and **Node.js** products, owning budgets, QA, and hiring.
Led engineering through the full SDLC with hands-on review, testing standards, and CI/CD on **AWS**, **Heroku**, and **Firebase**.
Shipped **Ionic** apps to both mobile stores with in-app subscriptions and **Stripe** payments.
